title: Reading Faded Ink
transcript: Imagine opening a manuscript and finding that the faintest lines are also the most fragile. In our study of an early handwritten ledger, we began by photographing each page under angled light, which revealed shallow pen grooves. To keep the camera at a fixed distance while we worked, we supported it on a copy stand. A small colour card appeared in every frame so that we could compare images taken on different days. We then photographed the same pages under infrared illumination. That made some words easier to read, particularly near the centre of the page, but it offered little improvement along the stained outer edge. The difference matters when an archive plans its work. A trial should include several parts of a page before anyone commits to photographing a whole volume by the same method.

questions.prompt: Lighting used to reveal shallow marks left by the pen: ____
questions.explanation: 斜射光让笔尖留下的浅痕显现出来。

questions.prompt: The camera was supported on a copy ____.
questions.explanation: 研究人员用翻拍架固定相机与页面之间的距离。

questions.prompt: Each photograph included a small colour ____.
questions.explanation: 每张照片都包含一张色卡，便于比较不同日期拍摄的图像。

options: It improved legibility mainly near the middle of the page.
It recovered most of the writing along the stained margin.
It improved legibility to a similar degree across the page.
questions.answer: It improved legibility mainly near the middle of the page.
questions.explanation: 红外成像主要让页面中央附近的字迹更易辨认。

questions.prompt: What does the speaker suggest before adopting one method for an entire volume?
options: Photograph a complete volume as the first trial.
Test the method on multiple regions of a page.
Select the darkest writing as the sole test area.
questions.answer: Test the method on multiple regions of a page.
questions.explanation: 讲者建议先在同一页面的多个区域试验，再决定是否用同一种方法拍摄整册。
